Petitioner versus 1.The Commissioner of Police, No.132, E.V.K.Sampath Road, Vepery, Chennai - 600 007. 2.The Assistant Commissioner of Police, G-1 Police Station, Vepery, Chennai - 600 007. 3.The Inspector of Police, G-1 Police Station, Vepery, Chennai - 600 007. ... Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o India, seeking for a writ of mandamus, forbearing the respondents f from interfering with the peaceful conduct of the petitioner's rest business carried out in the name and style of Coin Cafe Restaurant No.20, New No.45, Mookathal Street, Purasaiwalkam, Chennai-600 007 along with hookah in a designated smoking zone in pursuance of the passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No.10846 of 201 (arising out of Slp (Civil) No.8143 of 2014). For Petitioner : Mr.R.Lakshmi Narasimhan For Respondents : Mr.S.Santhosh Government Advocate (Crl.Sid Order
texts.facts: This Writ Petition has been filed seeking for a mandamus to forbear the respondents from interfering with the peaceful conduct of the petitioner's restaurant business carried out in the name and style of Coin Cafe Restaurant at Old No.20, New No.45, Mookathal Street, Purasaiwalkam, Chennai-600 007 along with hookah in a designated smoking zone in pursuance of the order passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No.10846 of 2014 (arising out of SLP (Civil) No.8143 of 2014). https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2. The restaurant consists of 30 tables and specifically earmarked a place for smoking area with 'hookah' [tobacco products used into hookah pipe] are within the specified norms. Even though the petitioner is conducting his business in a lawful manner, the respondent police came to his premises and causes interference and hence, the petitioner has filed this writ for seeking a direction.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is a partner of Coin Cafe Restaurant situated in Old No.20, New No.45, Mookathal Street, Purasaiwalkam, Chennai-600 007. He had obtained license from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India on 18.03.2021. 3. The learned Government Advocate (Crl. Side) appearing for the respondents submitted that a case has been registered against the petitioner in Crime No.376 of 2022 for the offence under Section 37 of Tamil Nadu City Police Act on the file of the Sub Inspector of Police, G-1 Police Station, Vepery, Chennai.
texts.petitioner_arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is a partner of Coin Cafe Restaurant situated in Old No.20, New No.45, Mookathal Street, Purasaiwalkam, Chennai-600 007. He had obtained license from the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India on 18.03.2021. 3. The learned Government Advocate (Crl. Side) appearing for the respondents submitted that a case has been registered against the petitioner in Crime No.376 of 2022 for the offence under Section 37 of Tamil Nadu City Police Act on the file of the Sub Inspector of Police, G-1 Police Station, Vepery, Chennai.
